body:
Here’s the question:

 We are a new church plant in Johannesburg South Africa and our minister

reads and devours your thoughts and books.

When are you next in South Africa?

 You can find my schedule here on the site. I just returned from South Africa … and I don’t know when I’ll return. But I love your country and hope it’s soon! Later this year I’ll be in Australia and new Zealand.

I’m planning to cut my travel in half beginning next year, in part because I want to shrink my carbon footprint, and in part because I need more time to focus on writing and living at a sustainable pace. In the next couple years, I hope to get to Southeast Asia, Brazil, India, and Europe … maybe Russia and Central Asia at some point. I expect to be in East Africa again next May as well.
